newsitem.title: USA: Activists protest space monkey experiment.
newsitem.headline: Activists protest space monkey experiment.

text.p: Animal rights activists marched into the office of NASA chief Dan Goldin on Thursday and chained themselves together to protest against an upcoming mission to measure the effects of weightlessness on monkeys.

People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA), which issued a statement on the protest, said several activists were arrested after they demanded that Goldin halt the experimental programme, known as Bion.

Brian Dunbar, a spokesman for the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, confirmed that the protest took place and said that the Bion missions would monitor the physiological and behavioural responses of rhesus monkeys while in the near-weightless environment of Earth orbit.
Dunbar said that NASA has performed similar experiments on humans, and stressed that the monkeys would not be sacrificed during or after the experiment.

"The goals of the experiments are legitimate goals for space-based research and the protocols for conducting these experiments meet all of our standards for animal care and use," Dunbar said by telephone.
